nodes.label: Metric M4: function_scope
nodes.rationale: Separates warning-only systems from AEBS actuating systems, perception supply, and tracking only.

nodes.label: Composite Competitor Score Policy (Deliberate Non-Metric)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately omitted because 4 of 7 cohort members have unverified unit prices and 0 of 7 hold Indian certification; ranking would score source availability rather than competitive position.

nodes.label: G.S.R. 184(E)
nodes.rationale: Superseded draft rules dated 20 March 2025; not the operative compliance instrument

nodes.label: G.S.R. 862(E)
nodes.rationale: Substituted rule 96(12) for AEBS/Vehicle Stability Function and rule 93(1)(B)(i) for ADAS sensor casing exclusions

nodes.label: A100 One-Channel M.2 Module
nodes.rationale: Smallest configuration; packages the SoC2 die onto an M.2 module for single camera channel integration into customer enclosures.

nodes.label: Per-Core Local DMA (LDMA) Architecture
nodes.rationale: Replaces single shared DMA engine that starved 8 cores (utilization <=12%, 470ms/frame) with 8 local engines (utilization ~59%, 85ms/frame).

nodes.label: SoC2 Perception Compute
nodes.rationale: Hardware reduction becomes 3D cube depth on 28nm silicon; each compute cube runs local DMA against 8-bank L2 to maintain high utilisation instead of starving on a single global DMA.

nodes.label: T100 AI Licence (SaaS)
nodes.rationale: Sells India-road perception models and toolchain without hardware/BoM; priced on value (₹100L unit price) at pure margin.

nodes.label: A100 Four-Channel PCIe Card
nodes.rationale: PCIe card supporting four camera inputs; exercises the full memory bandwidth and local DMA architecture of the compute cube.

nodes.label: A100 Two-Channel Module
nodes.rationale: Board-level module (₹25k) supporting two camera inputs; entry point where sensor fusion justifies dedicated transformer hardware.

nodes.label: Autonomous TaaS (Fleet & Mobility)
nodes.rationale: Operates company-owned vehicles on fixed routes under contract (billed per trip/tonne) capturing operating margin rather than hardware margin (₹66L unit price).

nodes.label: DGrid Yard OS (Live Terminal Twin / PS18)
nodes.norm_label: dgrid yard os (live terminal twin / ps18)
nodes.rationale: Simulator twin running production perception, dynamic fusion, congestion routing, and predictive ETA scheduling in shadow mode for port operators.

nodes.label: AD0 Smart Mirror (360 Surround-View)
nodes.rationale: Voluntary safety and convenience buy targeting 360 surround-view market

nodes.label: SoC2 Tapeout NRE and Capex Program
nodes.norm_label: soc2 tapeout nre and capex program
nodes.rationale: Tapeout NRE is the main equity-funded capex (~Rs 30 Cr), heavily front-loaded in FY27-FY28

nodes.label: SoC4 5nm Tape-out Program
nodes.rationale: High R&D sustained (~Rs 300 Cr cumulative) to self-fund the next-gen 5nm chip for L4/robotaxi directly from operating profit

nodes.label: TaaS Fleet Debt Financing
nodes.rationale: TaaS fleet capex (~Rs 60 Cr) is debt/lease financed against trucks to avoid draining equity cash

nodes.label: CGTMSE-Backed Working Capital Facility
nodes.rationale: 10 Cr collateral-free MSME facility utilised at 25% drawdown as non-dilutive capital to preserve equity for silicon development.

nodes.label: Fabless Semiconductor Model
nodes.rationale: Avoids fabrication capex, keeping D&A modest and generating low-to-mid 30s% EBITDA margins at scale.

nodes.label: FPGA-to-ASIC Transition
nodes.rationale: Reduces die cost ~16x at volume and expands gross margin structurally from 53% to 88%.

nodes.label: SoC2 Platform
nodes.rationale: Core platform sustained by run-rate R&D driving initial ADAS revenue.

nodes.label: Cash Flow & Runway Financial Model
nodes.rationale: Evaluates whether the Rs 45 Cr round carries the company to self-funding, front-loading tapeout NRE and financing TaaS fleet via debt

nodes.label: Business Plan v2 Modelling Assumptions
nodes.rationale: Fabless die margin scales to ~94% as wafer-cost falls and mask amortizes

nodes.label: FPGA Break-even Economics
nodes.rationale: Team opex of ₹4-6 Cr/yr requires 400-600 kits/yr to break even at ₹1.04L gross profit per kit; FY27 plans only 130 kits, making it deliberately loss-making and round-funded.

nodes.label: Service and Support Reserve
nodes.rationale: Added 5-8% ASP explicit service reserve based on AIS-140 lessons where devices were tampered with within a year without ongoing support.

nodes.label: Milestone-Linked CCPS Structure
nodes.rationale: Replaces tranche gates and clawbacks; investor fully funds $1M upfront at a single certified price complying with FEMA, while conversion ratio flexes based on growth milestones.

nodes.label: Two-Tranche Structure Failure Rationale
nodes.rationale: Two-tranche structure is unexecutable because rising fair value prevents second tranche issuance under FEMA Rule 21 at prior price without severe penalties, valuation certificates expire within 90 days, and clawbacks against non-residents face transfer-pricing constraints.

nodes.label: Route X1: Long-Haul Driverless Autonomy (Rejected)
nodes.rationale: Explicitly rejected because well-funded competitors (Aurora, Kodiak, Waabi) possess hundreds of millions in capital and multi-year leads, and regulatory hurdles demand 500,000 test miles per phase.

nodes.label: Route V2: Yard and Private-Land Autonomy
nodes.norm_label: route v2: yard and private-land autonomy
nodes.rationale: Chosen for immediate entry because private land requires no FMVSS compliance, no AV permit, and no multi-decade supply longevity commitment.

nodes.label: SKU S6: Yard Autonomy Stack
nodes.rationale: Prioritised for initial US market commercialisation because it circumvents FMVSS and highway AV permitting.

nodes.label: Kodiak-Bosch Partnership Model
nodes.rationale: Kodiak partnered with component supplier Bosch to scale hardware, serving as DeepGrid's exact strategic template for V1 to enter as a component supplier rather than competing directly.

nodes.label: Supplier and Licensor Entry Strategy
nodes.rationale: Autonomous trucking competitors raised ~$5.6B vs DeepGrid's ₹45 Cr (~$5.4M, a 1000:1 ratio); DeepGrid enters as supplier/licensor to avoid unwinnable direct competition.

nodes.label: MicroDC-A1
nodes.rationale: 4U footprint fits standard telecom edge cabinets; liquid cooling enables deployment without facility upgrades

nodes.label: Four Load-Bearing Forecast Assumptions
nodes.rationale: Identifies vulnerabilities: high FY27 defence revenue assumption, opex scaling directly with misses, unit capture rates, and die cost breakeven volumes.

nodes.label: Schedule Slip and Fixed-Cost Floor Testing
nodes.norm_label: schedule slip and fixed-cost floor testing
nodes.rationale: Recommended scenario test instead of pure demand variation, testing a 6-month silicon slip and rigid fixed costs.

nodes.label: MoRTH GSR 184(E) AIS Mandate
nodes.rationale: Acts as demand floor for ADAS on commercial N2/N3 trucks (DDAWS, blind-spot, LDWS)

nodes.label: UC-03 Blind-Spot & Moving-Off Information
nodes.rationale: Near-field VRU perception fulfilling AIS-186 and AIS-187 without manual deactivation.

nodes.label: UC-04 Driver Drowsiness and Attention
nodes.rationale: Delivers in-cab drowsiness pipeline alongside completed 10-participant day-and-night documentation package for AIS-184.

nodes.label: UC-05 Lane Departure Warning
nodes.rationale: Drivable-corridor estimation without painted lines for AIS-188 compliance on degraded highways.

nodes.label: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India (CVCS)
nodes.norm_label: zf commercial vehicle control systems india (cvcs)

nodes.label: DeepGrid Product Bounding Statement
nodes.rationale: DeepGrid sells a bounded camera-perception subsystem inside an accountable integrator's safety case and does not own brake actuation, calibration, homologation, or warranty.

nodes.label: UC-01 AEBS Forward-Path Perception
nodes.rationale: Budget between warning (1.4s) and braking (TTC 3.0s) under Rule 96(12) is a perception problem; braking actuation stays with the Tier-1.

nodes.label: UC-02 Nuisance-Alert Suppression
nodes.rationale: Without scenario-stratified denominators against a named baseline, false-positive claims are discounted to zero in Tier-1 reviews.

nodes.label: UC-03 Blind-Spot and Moving-Off Information (BSIS/MOIS)
nodes.rationale: Signals cannot be switched off under AIS-186, so nuisance suppression is a mandatory prerequisite to avoid permanent peripheral driver distraction.

nodes.label: UC-04 Driver Drowsiness and Attention (DDAWS)
nodes.rationale: AIS-184 approval requires a full 10-participant day/night study rather than just an algorithmic demonstration.

nodes.label: UC-05 Lane Departure Warning (LDWS)
nodes.rationale: Indian highway corridors frequently lack markings; corridor estimation must fuse road edges, kerbs, and flow cues instead of relying only on painted lines.

nodes.label: UC-06 Government and PSU Perception Kit
nodes.norm_label: uc-06 government and psu perception kit
nodes.rationale: Bridges revenue until H1 2028 qualified volume silicon by packaging FPGA modules as Class-I local-content kits on GeM.

nodes.label: DGrid Micro DC-A1 Chassis
nodes.rationale: Liquid-cooled 4U rack-mount sovereign AI datacenter compute box packaging 4x SoC4-A chips to allow telecom edge and on-premise inference without facility overhauls.

nodes.label: BU03 Mobility (Autonomous Freight)
nodes.rationale: Focuses on Indian logistics routes and port AGVs where North American autonomous truck operators cannot bid or operate.

nodes.label: DeepGrid Manufacturing Partners (Embedded IoT & Sulakshna)
nodes.rationale: Engaged Embedded IoT (Hyderabad) for PCBA/QFN-128 packaging and Sulakshna for 6-layer automotive PCBs to secure a contracted supply chain.

nodes.label: DGrid MicroDC-A1
nodes.rationale: Packages automotive-grade SoC4-A silicon into a 4U liquid-cooled edge rack module for sovereign-AI inference and robo-taxi fleet compute

nodes.label: Silicon Cost Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: $3-4 bare die figure was rejected as too optimistic to underwrite; ₹1,750 packaged and tested 28nm part was adopted for all margin math.

nodes.label: Brogen EV
nodes.rationale: Treated as partner domain for chassis and e-axles to keep DeepGrid focused strictly on high-margin semiconductor and software IP.

nodes.label: ADAS Product Family (AD0-AD4)
nodes.rationale: Standardises on a common platform and mirror upgrade ladder so customers don't lose trained AI data when upgrading

nodes.label: Batch Dispatch Firmware (Patent 1)
nodes.rationale: Decouples inference execution from RISC-V host supervision, making ALU active 200x longer per cycle and achieving 68.7 effective TOPS on 42mm²

nodes.label: Six-Chiplet Combo Die (~57.1mm²)
nodes.rationale: Unlocks six independent business revenues from a single $2.42M NRE tapeout on TSMC 28nm HPC+ instead of requiring separate tapeouts at $15M+

nodes.label: H100 Chiplet (Health AI Processor)
nodes.rationale: 24-bit bio-ADC allows <1mW continuous monitoring of driver fatigue with AEB integration

nodes.label: R100 Chiplet (Radar DSP)
nodes.rationale: 12-bit native radar ADC preserves full dynamic range and delivers 4x better detection in low-SNR monsoon/fog conditions instead of re-quantising to INT16

nodes.label: S100 Chiplet (SDV / Vehicle Gateway)
nodes.rationale: Natively provides compliant AIS-140 telematics and AUTOSAR Adaptive gateway built into AD0-AD4 kits

nodes.label: D100 Chiplet (Defence)
nodes.rationale: Integrates lockstep RISC-V safety cores and AES-256 secure enclave on the shared die at zero additional design cost.

nodes.label: DGrid Alpha
nodes.rationale: Consolidates six chiplets on a single 28nm die across automotive, defence, and industrial autonomy to amortise tapeout costs and deliver hardware fail-safe coupling.

nodes.label: Hardware Fail-Safe Architecture
nodes.rationale: Fuses Flight Control (FC), Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO), and AI onto the same die to eliminate inter-chip latency, weight, power, and bus failure points when GPS/comms are denied.

nodes.label: Compute Tile Mesh Scaling Architecture
nodes.rationale: Replicates a single small tile in expanding 2D meshes (1 to 1024 tiles) to scale from vehicles to data-centre AI without redesigning the architecture.

nodes.label: 8x8x8 Systolic Cube Architecture
nodes.rationale: K becomes hardware depth so one K-slice retires per cycle via pipelined DSP cascade, packing 512 MACs per cube and 39.3 TOPS across 64 cubes at 600 MHz.

nodes.label: Jiyu Technology
nodes.rationale: Retained as drive-by-wire partner rather than reselling their hardware because reselling actuation adds no margin or IP moat.

nodes.label: Route X2: Direct Fleet Retrofit Sales (Rejected)
nodes.norm_label: route x2: direct fleet retrofit sales (rejected)
nodes.rationale: Rejected because incumbent telematics and camera vendors (Samsara, Lytx, Motive, Netradyne) dominate the direct fleet relationship at bundled software rates.

nodes.label: SKU S1: IP Block Licence
nodes.rationale: Carries no longevity gate or hardware qualification burden since delivery is soft RTL.

nodes.label: SKU S2: Perception Model Licence
nodes.rationale: Carries no qualification burden or longevity commitment because it is delivered purely as software, weights, and toolchain.

nodes.label: AIS-004 Native Compliance
nodes.rationale: Regulatory moat requiring Indian OEMs to adopt India-certified solutions for retrofit/commercial deployments

nodes.label: 15 Provisional Patent Applications
nodes.rationale: Must be converted to complete specifications within 12 months of priority date (expires March 2027)

nodes.label: Gahan AI
nodes.rationale: Radar platform using TI AWR2944 with no OEM route to market.

nodes.label: 4D Imaging Radar Pod
nodes.rationale: Monetises existing die real estate because the R100 radar DSP block was already integrated and paid for in the primary tapeout

nodes.label: T100 Perception Software Licence
nodes.rationale: Starts later in FY2029 because software licensing requires an established field track record before adoption; operates with zero bill of materials at 94% margin

nodes.label: Transport as a Service (TaaS)
nodes.rationale: Captures higher operating margins rather than hardware margins by booking the complete transport contract, targeting routes constrained by severe commercial driver shortages

nodes.label: LWIR Thermal Camera Pod
nodes.rationale: Positioned as a capability line at 50% margin rather than a profit driver to eliminate perception failure modes in unlit roads, glare, dust, and smoke

nodes.label: Defence D-HUMR UGV
nodes.rationale: Replaces human personnel in high-risk logistics and perimeter reconnaissance; validated early on FPGA hardware to achieve early external programme validation

nodes.label: H100 Driver Monitor Wearable
nodes.rationale: Priced at ₹5,000 as a strategic channel acquisition tool rather than a profit line, bypassing driver privacy resistance against in-cabin cameras

nodes.label: DGrid Sentinel Perimeter Threat Fusion
nodes.rationale: Benign tracks are held and never escalated to avoid false alarms getting perimeter systems switched off.

nodes.label: 4D Radar Pod SKU
nodes.rationale: A measured closing speed stands up where an estimated one does not, making braking decisions defensible.

nodes.label: Thermal Camera SKU
nodes.rationale: Carries real component cost, half group average gross margin (50%), positioned to raise capability of surrounding products rather than carry the plan.

nodes.label: SoC4-A Far Horizon
nodes.rationale: Optionality sitting outside the current fundraising plan, based on 1024 tiles on a 4nm process using PULP platform.

nodes.label: D-HUMR Defence UGV
nodes.rationale: Standalone SPV carve-out vector with D100

nodes.label: FPGA Bridge Window Strategy
nodes.rationale: Silicon arrives late after mandate dates, so shipping FPGA products to Government/PSU channels generates critical telemetry for Tier-1 design-in.

nodes.label: SoC2 28nm Die
nodes.rationale: One single 28nm tapeout / mask with six chiplets downstream powering all 15 SKUs to amortize NRE.

nodes.label: Seaport AGV
nodes.rationale: Validates the silicon in port infrastructure with high revenue per unit.

nodes.label: D100 Drone SoC Kit
nodes.rationale: Opens aerial perception market leveraging the same SoC2 die with distinct firmware.

nodes.label: Defence D-HUMR
nodes.rationale: Opens defence procurement channel and validates ruggedised silicon at highest unit price point.

nodes.label: H100 Driver Monitor
nodes.rationale: Mandate requires in-cabin driver monitoring across commercial vehicles, driving sensor volume.

nodes.label: Autonomous TaaS
nodes.rationale: Proof that the same silicon running in a kit can run an entire metered transport operation.

nodes.label: CGTMSE Debt Facility
nodes.rationale: Non-dilutive working-capital overdraft facility of ₹10 Cr

nodes.label: Grants & Prior Funding
nodes.rationale: Prior non-dilutive and angel funding including ARAI certification, HDFC Parivartan, and Angel equity

nodes.rationale: Unit cost comparisons must strictly match scope; disallows unverified claims such as retracted 774x and 12.9x comparisons against incumbents.

nodes.label: DGrid Alpha SoC (Single-Die 6-Chiplet)
nodes.rationale: Consolidates AI processing (A100), radar DSP (R100), secure computing (D100), vehicle telematics (S100), and bio-ADC (H100) onto a single silicon substrate to reduce BOM and physical footprint

nodes.rationale: Bypasses automotive OEM validation queues by deploying FPGA-based prototypes directly into defense UGVs, drones, and port AGVs to generate immediate cash-flow and validate real-world algorithms

nodes.rationale: Targets domestic Indian and GCC commercial vehicle OEMs through Tier-1 component suppliers to absorb vehicle integration liabilities and simplify multi-ECU BOM complexity

nodes.label: MeitY Design Linked Incentive (DLI) Scheme
nodes.rationale: Leveraged to offset EDA tool licensing, foundry MPW fabrication costs, and provide deployment subsidies

nodes.label: 3D Systolic Tensor Cube
nodes.rationale: Specifically engineered to run localized perception models at high framerates on mature silicon to eliminate false positives in unstructured traffic

nodes.label: Tier-1 Component Suppliers
nodes.rationale: Absorbs physical assembly, long-term warranties, and validation liabilities, serving as the bridge to conservative automotive OEMs

nodes.label: High-Margin Tiered SaaS Subscriptions
nodes.rationale: Generates recurring post-installation revenue across Base Compliance, Advanced Autonomy, and Premium Autonomy tiers

nodes.label: TSMC 28nm HPC+ MPW Shuttle
nodes.rationale: Shares mask-set costs across multiple designs on a single reticle to reduce first-silicon costs compared to leading-edge FinFET nodes

nodes.label: Six-Chiplet Combo Die
nodes.rationale: One TSMC 28nm HPC+ tapeout (~57.1mm²) generating six independent revenue streams to avoid six separate tapeouts and qual cycles costing $15M+.
